game_updates.title: Same Route 66. Different Problems.
game_updates.contents: What if we looked at the same road from a different door? Hey Gas Jockeys! When we were working on Gas Station Simulator, we spent a lot of time thinking about Route 66. Not just what it should look like, but what it should feel like. We wanted that feeling of being somewhere in the middle of nowhere, where the road seems endless and the next car could bring absolutely anyone to your doorstep. That's part of what made the gas station so much fun to build. It's a small place, but the world keeps coming to it. Travelers stop for fuel, grab something to eat, look around the store, and then disappear back onto the road. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/cd298f898a4791bedc5892dc1096b4a1f8b190c3.png After spending so much time with that idea, we started wondering about the other places along Route 66....

game_updates.contents: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/f0181be23d05713ccf626ce82726463c1a60f2ed.png Hello friends! The meta is perfect. Said no one ever. To be fair, the meta is in a decent place. Yes, there are a few cards and archetypes that are causing issues and we will be addressing them in this patch, slated to launch alongside the Ring of Fire mini-set on September 10th. While a few decks are basking in the limelight at this current moment, they are not overwhelmingly more powerful than the next tier of good decks, like has sometimes been the case in the past. game_updates.title: 3.26.3.11 Patch Notes
game_updates.contents: This security patch addresses a reported exploit. We have banned a Workshop file containing the exploit which had 1 active subscriber. We are not aware of any confirmed cases of players being affected by this file. (Thanks Jackzebra!) As a reminder, please use caution when accepting unexpected server invites or joining servers from people you do not trust. We have recently seen an increase in reports involving malicious Workshop content.
